notes: The farm, the edge of the field, the well and the scrub sit on 1A's foreign_farm frame; the two roads west are local grids; the road home sits on Scene 2's eliab_valley frame at road_mile_end (1400, -630), where the road first comes into view of Eliab's gate.
The farm dog leads the camera up from the reapers to the table and leaves the edge of the field with the bread, so the Sc 4 flash is cut from W12 between 7 and 12 s.
The father's hand rests on the younger son's head from W06 into W09, so Asher sees it from the wall; the cut into W09 is the deliberate break that reveals who has been watching.
Between W09 and W10 Asher slips unseen along the ditch, through the field gap and up the fold's east side behind the oven into the pantry; the cut carries that time.
W11 runs with him as 1A's signature move does, so the theft and the lynching share one running camera, and the barley heads stitch it into the edge of the field.
The elder son reaches the pantry door as Asher bursts out and stays close behind for the whole run; the younger son follows, so both brothers sit down again in W17.
The catch ends at the wall's field face, about 3 m across the stones from 1A's beating on the road side.
The well is staged at noon, later than the morning theft and just after 1A's white-noon beating.
He wakes on 1A's scrub_rest spot with his head 0.4 m west; the scrub windows travel an arm's length at a time, a near-stillness chosen for the exhausted body.
The hired men are 1A's four, numbered 4 to 7; man 7 looks at the ribs and looks away, the same man bent over at the lip in 1A.
